scope.claim: small field or laboratory agricultural-soil microrelief calibration

hard_gates: downloadable measured 3D surface geometry or raw observations sufficient to reconstruct it
explicit tillage, soil, and moisture or surface-state semantics
independent dimensional metrology, checkpoints, or numeric error contract
reusable public license covering derived and training use
measured support sufficient to evaluate B1, preferably B2
not a raster-only or figure-only release

decision.reason: The capped tranche contains no public release combining agricultural-soil semantics with downloadable 3D geometry and an independent error contract.
decision.fallback: Do not download these releases. Continue only with a source whose repository manifest proves geometry, labels, rights, and metrology before acquisition.
not_authorized: substituting rendered images or aggregate roughness values for measured geometry

dataset.title: Surface roughness dataset
dataset.description: Profilometer raw data and morphology images for ceramic and steel microsphere-based radiative-cooling coatings.

blocking_reasons: The measured materials are engineered ceramic and steel coatings, not soil.
The official manifest exposes rendered 3D and surface PNGs, one-dimensional section text, and summary CSVs rather than an agricultural-soil height field or point cloud.
No tillage, soil texture, moisture, or independent soil-surface error contract exists.

dataset.title: Soil Surface Micro-Topography by Structure-from-Motion Photogrammetry for Monitoring Density and Erosion Dynamics
dataset.site: three 1.0 m by 1.5 m plots on a maize-cultivated hillslope at ZALF Muencheberg, northeastern Germany
dataset.semantics: coarse-textured Luvisol topsoil after uniform tillage and sowing, including tractor lane, seed rows, unconsolidated soil, rainfall history, and measured bulk density

published_measurement_contract.source: close-range SfM from repeated 5 MP-equivalent images
published_measurement_contract.control: four reconstructed control points assigned measured local coordinates
published_measurement_contract.error_reporting: per-date level of detection discussed in the article, but no independent checkpoint coordinate set or reusable numeric XY/Z error artifact is released

blocking_reasons: The data-availability statement points only to the article and supplementary material; it does not publish raw photographs, reconstructed point clouds, or machine-readable height fields.
The supplementary appendices contain workflow and DEM figures, not reconstructable metric geometry.
Control relocation and interpolation are acknowledged uncertainty sources, but no reusable independent checkpoint distribution with numeric horizontal and vertical errors is released.
candidates.resume_condition: A public repository release of the original images or point clouds, control and checkpoint coordinates, per-epoch error logs, and explicit reuse license.

dataset.title: Processed data for event-scale sheet erosion monitoring using time-lapse camera Structure-from-Motion and a colored surface-soil tracer
dataset.site: artificial landslide slope in northern Japan
dataset.declared_contents: rainfall time series and event data, sheet-erosion indices, environmental and topographic variables, and shapefiles for analysis points and plot layout

blocking_reasons: The release explicitly contains processed figure-support data rather than raw camera observations, point clouds, or metric surface grids.
Its surface is an artificial landslide slope with colored tracer, not a documented agricultural tillage and soil-state treatment.
No independent dimensional control or band-resolved measurement error contract accompanies reusable geometry because reusable geometry is absent.
